recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century portrait of a smiling man in a textured green knit sweater leaning against a park lamppost, framed by bold, two-tone sans-serif typography and a small whimsical cartoon illustration in the upper corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The green of the sweater anchors the primary color palette and links to the large green display text.
The verticality of the lamppost balances the subject's slight diagonal lean.
The soft-focus park background provides depth without competing with the sharp foreground subject and graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Large-scale sans-serif display type at the top
Whimsical, flat-color cartoon vignette in the upper right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-shot of a man, slightly off-center to the left, leaning against a prominent lamppost on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, ornate base of the lamppost and the vibrant green sweater.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large green title, moves down to the subject's face, follows the line of the lamppost, and ends at the small cartoon illustration.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space in the upper third for typography and in the background for atmospheric depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Kelly Green (sweater and primary title text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Naturalistic browns and muted greens (background park scene)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in foreground graphic elements and clothing against a low-saturation, high-key background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to green, blue, and natural earth tones.

letterConstructionRules: Slightly rounded corners on the green display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Apostrophe styled as a simple vertical or slightly slanted wedge
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric sans-serif for impact paired with a condensed version for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Flat-style cartoon illustration with thin outlines

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and mid-century feel of the primary text.
Provides the geometric structure seen in the letterforms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with a short 1960s haircut, smiling, wearing a thick-ribbed green shawl-collar sweater. He is leaning against a dark, ornate metal lamppost in a park with blurred trees and rocks in the background. In the top right corner, include a small, simple 1960s-style cartoon of a man and woman near a clock tower.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, all-caps sans-serif text across the top. The main title should be in vibrant green and the secondary name in cornflower blue. Ensure tight kerning and a centered layout.

verificationChecks: Is the sweater texture highly visible?
Is the typography the heaviest visual element?
Does the cartoon illustration look flat and hand-drawn?
Is the background sufficiently out of focus?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the green of the text matches the green of the sweater.
Ensure the lamppost doesn't obscure the subject's face.
Verify the cartoon is small and tucked into the corner.
Confirm the text is perfectly horizontal and centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-texture portrait in a specific primary color with matching heavy geometric sans-serif display type and a whimsical corner illustration.
